# NOMINA Communication

> NOMINA is a full-service creative communication agency based in Milan, Italy. We design dynamic communication ecosystems across strategy, branding, digital experiences, content production, 3D design, PR, events, and AI integration.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://nomina-creative.com): Full overview of NOMINA Creative, featured creative showreel, ecosystem philosophy, client roster, and core services.
- [About](https://nomina-creative.com/about): Agency background, creative legacy, team culture, leadership, and our multidisciplinary approach.
- [Portfolio](https://nomina-creative.com/portfolio): Selected agency portfolio showcasing creative campaigns, branding, interactive digital projects, and 3D visual designs.
- [Career](https://nomina-creative.com/career): Career opportunities, company culture, open roles, and talent network at NOMINA.
- [3D Designer Role](https://nomina-creative.com/career-3d-designer): Role overview, responsibilities, requirements, and qualifications for 3D Designers.
- [Account Executive Role](https://nomina-creative.com/career-account-executive): Role overview, responsibilities, requirements, and qualifications for Account Executives.
- [Job Application](https://nomina-creative.com/job-application): Direct candidate application and CV submission portal with PocketBase backend integration.
- [Contact](https://nomina-creative.com/contact): Contact details, studio address, inquiry forms, and collaboration requests.

## Contact & Information
- Website: https://nomina-creative.com
- Headquarters: South Jakarta, Indonesia
